title: Law to require annual audit of police domestic incident reports
summary: This bill would require the Department of Investigation to audit the NYPD's use of domestic incident reports annually and report findings to the Council. The report would include data on completion rates, missing fields, timeliness, referrals given to victims and orders of protection, broken down by borough, council district and precinct. The first audit would be due within 180 days of enactment.
